title: Skull Sunflower Sorceress
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene features a large cracked skull on the ground with bright yellow sunflowers in its eye sockets and a miniature house with a red-and-white striped roof emerging from its cranium. A female figure with magenta hair, yellow gear-like goggles, a black corset and tutu stands atop the skull, dynamically posed while wielding a glowing yellow katana, surrounded by swirling sunflower petals, sparks, and magical energy trails.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy artwork of a giant cracked grey skull resting in a pool of red liquid, with large vibrant sunflowers growing from its eye sockets and a small house with red striped roof built inside its cranium. A fierce female character with flowing magenta hair, yellow mechanical goggles, black corset and pleated skirt stands atop the skull in a dynamic pose, swinging a glowing yellow katana. Swirling trails of sunflowers, sparks, and magical energy surround her against a dark background with floating white paper fragments.
